prompt_diff_summary: Added two instruction blocks to system.md: (1) a directive to treat the policy's own 'The current time is ...' line as the sole source of truth for 'today' and never substitute a real-world/model-believed date when judging whether a flight is past or upcoming, and (2) a directive to use search_direct_flight/search_onestop_flight (or reservation data) plus calculate to answer flight-duration/layover questions instead of claiming the data is unavailable and transferring.
helper_diff_summary: Added helper.py with an extra_context(policy) hook that extracts the policy's 'The current time is ...' sentence via regex and re-appends it as a reminder block at the end of the system prompt (recency-weighted reinforcement); no hard-coded dates or task-specific values.
risks: If the test split's policy ever omits the 'The current time is ...' sentence or phrases it differently, the regex in helper.py will match nothing and extra_context returns '', which is a safe no-op (falls back to the system.md instruction alone) rather than breaking anything.

The duration-reasoning instruction for task 44 nudges the agent to call search_direct_flight/search_onestop_flight more readily; this could very slightly increase tool-call counts on unrelated tasks, but should not change final DB state or communicated facts since it only applies when duration/layover is asked about.

Strengthening 'do not transfer' language could in rare cases make the agent persist on a genuinely unsolvable request instead of transferring; mitigated by keeping the original transfer_to_human_agents tool-description criterion ('cannot be handled within scope') as the explicit standard.

changes.what: Instructs the agent to use only the policy's stated current time for judging past vs. future flights, explicitly overriding any other date belief.
changes.why: Multiple transcripts show the agent stating 'current date is 2026-09-15' and then wrongly treating in-policy 2024-05 flights as already flown, causing incorrect refusals/transfers (tasks 24, 39, 22, 14, 25, 11, 23).

changes.what: Instructs the agent to derive flight duration/layover from search_direct_flight/search_onestop_flight results and calculate rather than declaring it unavailable, and to reserve transfer_to_human_agents for genuinely unsolvable requests.
changes.why: Task 44 transcript: agent said 'the tools available to me do not include flight duration or detailed layover time information' and asked to transfer, when the search tools return scheduled times the agent could reason over.

changes.what: Extracts the policy's 'The current time is ...' sentence via regex and appends it again as a reminder block at the end of the system prompt.
changes.why: The current-time line sits near the top of a long policy; repeating it at the end (recency-favoured position) reinforces it against the model's tendency to substitute a real-world date, without hard-coding any date so it generalises to the test split's policy.
